harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 49 requests of probe.py 34 (seventh build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions. (1) s_* (7 requests) - a SET of producers of one thread in flight under ONE predicate, every member on the same write barrier with the yield flag, the one wait on a word that reads no member, one cycle in front of the first reader word: the forms N,gN,gN (an unguarded `LDG.E.CONSTANT` and two guarded ones) and N,i,gN,gN (with a `SHFL.IDX` behind the first); _l = "pthird": "lane" - the THIRD WRITE OF THE ONE PREDICATE is a word from another condition, `ISETP.NE.AND P0, PT, R31, RZ, PT` with R31 = the lane, one cycle in front of the waiting word, while both guarded loads fly; _s = "sreader": "set" - the FIRST READER behind the wait is a `SHFL.IDX` of the unguarded load's register; _ls = both; the guards are a bit of the iteration counter (cc) or false in every lane (ff); the members 1 and 4 cycles apart. (2) v_* (3 requests) - a set of two `SHFL.IDX` whose ONE reader word is a guarded store, `@!P0 STS.128`, with P0 = (lane != 0) written from the lane register: the store executes in ONE lane of 32 and is nullified in the others, so one thread of 32 can show a stale store; the wait on the store itself (v_ii_gs_l) or on a word in front of it that reads no member (v_ii_gs_f_l), 1, 4 and 11 cycles; v_ii_gs_l_n is the control without barrier and wait (1, 2 and 4 cycles: it must not be right). (3) w_yil_b - a set of `SYNCS.CCTL.IVALL`, `SHFL.IDX` and `LDCU.64` whose ONE wait is carried by an event word, `BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING 0x0` (the wait and the yield flag, stall 6) behind `WARPSYNC.ALL` (the yield flag, stall 5); w_yil_b_n is its control with the pair in the same place, no barrier and no wait. (4) p_a, p_b - the replay of the reference word of an earlier batch without any marker (`S2R R31, SR_CgaCtaId` at stall 2 on write barrier 0, read twice; p_b with a third read in front of it): a diagnostic of that batch's reference kernels, it measures no pair. (5) f_* (35 requests) - THE DIAGNOSTIC OF THE WAIT BEHIND ONE PRODUCER: the producer alone on write barrier 1, its destination holding a marker from the top of every iteration, the word that carries the wait as the NEXT word behind it, the producer's stall count swept (1 ... 8 cycles = the distance of the waiting word); twelve producers - `MUFU.EX2` (f_mex), `MUFU.RCP` (f_mrc), `I2F.RP` (f_i2f), `F2I.FTZ.U32.TRUNC.NTZ` (f_f2i), `F2F.BF16.F32` (f_f2f), `SHFL.IDX` (f_shx), `S2R R32, SR_LTMASK` (f_ltm), `LDCU` (f_lcu), `LDC.64` (f_lc64), the register-indexed `LDC` (f_lcx), `@P0 LDG.E.CONSTANT` (f_pld) - each waited by its first reader - and `LDG.E` (f_wld), waited by a word that is not its reader (`IADD3 R15`), the reader one cycle behind that word; three variants: f_<x> = no word carries the yield flag; f_<x>_y = THE PRODUCER carries the yield flag (the waiting word never does); f_<x>_n = the control without barrier and wait (the reader 1, 2, 4, 8, 15 and 30 cycles behind the word: how long the word takes by itself; f_wld has none). Fronts of (2), (3), (4) and (5): no word in front, and fifteen `STS.128` at stall 4 in front - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone; this run launched every request but the two that hold a named-barrier word (w_yil_b, w_yil_b_n: the file _alone_2)
